visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair, wearing a white lace long-sleeved top and a white pencil skirt, leans against a dark wooden wall in a brightly lit hallway. She turns toward the camera with a bright smile. (2) The scene shifts to the woman standing in a modern clinic lobby, next to a large vertical promotional banner for 'onda'. The background features a large bronze-colored wall with a medical clinic logo. (3) She is then seen sitting on a white curved sofa in a luxurious clinic lounge area with floor-to-ceiling windows showing an urban view. On a small coffee table, there are snacks, a tablet, and a small horse figurine. (4) Close-up shots of medical equipment with a digital interface, clinic amenities including white towels, toiletries in a drawer, and a plate of food and coffee served to her. (5) A male doctor in a grey uniform consults with the woman, pointing at her waist area while she stands in the clinic hallway. (6) The woman lies face down on a treatment bed in a dimly lit room while a doctor and a female assistant perform a procedure on her lower back and waist using a white and green handheld device. (7) Finally, she poses in the same hallway as the first phase, smiling and showing off her slim waist profile from various angles.
